# Icypeas

Icypeas is an email discovery and verification tool that allows users to find and verify professional email addresses using first name, last name, and company domain.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/icypeas/.

## Actions

- **Bulk Email Search**: Start a bulk email search job.
- **Check Search Progress** (read-only): Check the progress of a search by its ID.
- **Domain Scan**: Scan a domain for role-based email addresses.
- **Fetch Bulk Search Info** (read-only): Fetch information about bulk search files.
- **Fetch Subscription Information** (read-only): Fetch subscription and credit info.
- **Find Companies** (read-only): Search companies in Icypeas database.
- **Find Company URL**: Find a single company profile URL using a company name or domain.
- **Find People** (read-only): Search for people in the leads database.
- **Find Profile URL**: Find a single profile URL.
- **Find Profile URLs Bulk**: Perform bulk search for profile URLs.
- **Find Single Email**: Discover a single email address using a person's first or last name with a company domain or name.
- **Retrieve Search Results** (read-only): Retrieve the results of a search by ID or to paginate through bulk search results.
- **Scrape Company**: Scrape company profile information from a LinkedIn company URL.
- **Scrape Profile**: Initiate scraping of a LinkedIn profile.
- **Setup Notifications** (read-only): Set up push notifications.
- **Statistics Bulk Search** (read-only): Parse bulk search statistics webhook.
